event_text: r_c dares m_c to leap across the Silverpath in front of a Thundersnake near camp and is horrified when {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} stumbles and is struck.

history:.death: m_c died from being struck by a Thundersnake.

event_text: Driven to desperation by the greenleaf heat, m_c drinks from a foul-tasting puddle of water. The Clan finds {PRONOUN/m_c/object} dead in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} nest hours later.

history.death: m_c died after drinking poisoned water.

event_text: Starclan said that m_c would die from a great danger that would threaten the clan this moon, but {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} didn't know when yet. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} soon found out how soon when a pack of coyotes was chasing r_c through the territory and r_c, blinded by pure terror, didn't know that {PRONOUN/r_c/subject} {VERB/r_c/were/was} leading the coyotes toward the camp! Luckily, m_c was just nearby and noticed the coyotes chasing r_c. So m_c distracts the coyotes while r_c escapes and m_c loses a life or two as {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} gets mauled by the coyotes, saving the cats of c_n from the danger foretold.

history.lead_death: m_c was mauled by a pack of coyotes while saving r_c and whole the Clan

log.cats_from: cat_from heard about how cat_to lost most of {PRONOUN/cat_to/poss} lives while rescuing r_c and the rest of the Clan from coyotes.
cat_from honors cat_to for rescuing {PRONOUN/cat_fron/object} and the rest of c_n from coyotes.
